gameDescriptionHtml:
Uncursed is a first-person psychological horror game blending immersive storytelling, environmental exploration, and puzzle-solving. Navigate a house filled with unsettling secrets, uncover the dark past hidden beneath its walls, and escape before history repeats itself.

Alex thought he had left his past behind. But when his grandmother stops answering his calls, he returns home—only to find a place warped by time, filled with eerie remnants of forgotten rituals and a creeping presence that watches from the dark.

As he unravels the mystery surrounding his family, the walls begin to shift, shadows twist into something unnatural, and the truth he seeks may not be one he can survive.

With spine-tingling atmosphere, intense jump scares, and a haunting storyline, UNCURSED will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. Can you survive the horrors that await you?

Game Features

  • A Haunting Story – Unravel a mystery filled with loss, forgotten rituals, and the horrors of the past.
  • An Ever-Changing House – The environment twists and distorts as Alex uncovers buried secrets.
  • Exploration & Puzzle Solving – Search for clues, unlock hidden passages, and piece together the truth.
  • Unseen Forces – Feel the presence stalking you, hear whispers that were never meant for you, and question what is real.
  • Logic puzzles – These puzzles will require you to use your reasoning skills to solve them. For example, you may need to figure out a code or solve a mathematical equation.
  • Inventory puzzles – These puzzles will require you to use items from your inventory in order to solve them. For example, you may need to combine two items to create a new item.
  • Multiple Endings – Every choice matters. Will you break the curse, or will it consume you?
